description: This file implements a WebSocket server class (WSServer) with methods to listen for incoming connections, handle upgrades, and close the server. It manages WebSocket connections, delegates events, and integrates with HTTP server creation and WebSocket handling utilities.

classes.name: WSServer
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket server lifecycle, connection handling, and integration with HTTP server.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes WSServer with a delegate for handling events.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the HTTP and WebSocket server, sets up upgrade handling, and returns the WebSocket endpoint URL.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the WebSocket and HTTP servers, closing all active connections.
